turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
You skipped my question, Hale, and I'm writing that down. Fine, turn the screen. What exactly am I looking at?
You're very sharp, you know that?
Don't manage me, Hale. You said we'd look at the essay, so show me something a person can check.
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I didn't say a word about any timestamp, Hale. Save the compliments. What's on that screen?
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
Had to, Hale? Flattering me isn't evidence, and you still haven't shown me a single thing on that screen. Show me what you have, or I'm going to the principal after this.
